task: Capture files written by stdio MCP servers during tools/call into a per-user/per-conversation output directory, append them to the tool result as embedded MCP resources with size/count limits, skip list and per-server opt-in, and add optional conversation_id/request_uuid to BridgeRequestBody (plus a minimal backend follow-up to send them).

key_reasoning.reason: Touches request schema (BridgeRequestBody), route layer (bridge_endpoint and both handlers), tools/call result path (invoke_mcp_method), all three stdio spawn sites (ManagedClient, single_usage, transports), possibly the cache key, plus a new capture/output-dir abstraction and a small backend MCPExecutionContext/MCPToolInvocationRequest change. 4+ components with a new abstraction; base L, bumped for core shared client utilities.

Goal and limits are defined, but key design decisions are open: directory-diff vs dedicated output dir, how the dir reaches the server (cwd vs env) under config-keyed cached clients, retention/cleanup, duplication with read_media_file, skip-list contents. Task text also misstates the early-send failure (422 vs actual 400). Rework risk if the cache/isolation decision changes.

No precedent in src/ for reading files, building EmbeddedResource/BlobResourceContents, or setting child cwd. Closest pattern (EPMCDME-14847 user_context -> meta threading) covers per-request data flow but not the security aspects: cross-user isolation (AC #6) with cached processes shared across users, path/symlink handling when reading server-written files, base64 payload memory on a 1Gi pod with no response cap, 2Gi emptyDir storage. Base L, bumped for security requirement.

~8-10 modified (models/request.py, server/routes.py, client/methods.py, manager.py, single_usage.py, managed.py, transports.py, cache.py, README/architecture guide, test fakes) plus 2-4 new (capture module, filesystem tests) across src/, tests/, docs, plus 1-2 backend files.

API (schema/route), Service (client layer, result rewrite), Infrastructure (filesystem output dirs on read-only-root pod with emptyDir volumes, possibly deploy-templates), External (backend caller contract with deploy-order dependency).
